title: LabelledEmailRecord
description: One record in the labelled email dataset. JSONL format: one JSON object per line. Fields mirror docs/CONTRACTS.md §1 (Intent, ExtractedFields).

id.description: Unique identifier for this email record.

provider.description: Which mailbox provider this email was fetched from.

headers.description: Raw email headers relevant for auth checks and pre-filtering. Keys are lower-cased header names. At minimum include authentication-results and from.

authentication-results.description: SPF, DKIM and DMARC results as reported by the receiving MTA.

from.description: The raw From header value, e.g. 'Jane Doe <jane@example.com>'.

list-unsubscribe.description: List-Unsubscribe header if present (indicates bulk mail).

is_recruiter.description: Ground truth: is this email from a genuine recruiter?

intent.description: Ground truth intent, matching email_agent.contracts.Intent values.

fields.description: Ground truth extracted fields, matching ExtractedFields shape from contracts.

role.description: Job title or role mentioned in the email.

location.description: Job location or work arrangement mentioned.

candidate_names.description: Candidate names explicitly mentioned in the email.

resume_requested.description: Whether a resume was explicitly requested.

expected_profile_ids.description: Profile IDs that should match this requirement. Must be non-empty for new_requirement and resume_request intents.

notes.description: Free-text labelling notes: ambiguities, edge-case reasoning, anything a reviewer should know.
